findings.text: follow-on: `assert record["granted_paths"] == ["reckon/crew/claims.py"]` compares the record's field against the very literal the test handed the CLI one statement earlier (`_reopen(run_id, monkeypatch, path="reckon/crew/claims.py")`), so it is a round-trip echo rather than an independent check: the assertion holds for whatever value the reopen writes into the record as long as `_record_reopening` copies its own `granted_paths` argument, and it reddens only on the mutation that removes `_record_reopening` entirely (which the negative control exercises), never on a regression that records the wrong path. It does not carry the durability score, which rests on the manifest-status, classification and obligations assertions; the independent form would compare against the pointer's widened `write_paths` after the reopen.
